b0aa4b89be.q: How many youth age out of care annually in Canada and what challenges do they face without support systems?
b0aa4b89be.a: Over 5,000 youth age out of care every year in Canada. When they do so, they don't have someone in their corner supporting them with mental health, with education, mentoring them towards career trajectories. This creates a pipeline towards homelessness and incarceration. By the time these kids reach their 18th birthday or shortly after, they're aging out of a system without all of the supports that Canadians take for granted.

fe07feadc9.q: What is the YouthWorks program and how many youth has it served since 2017?
fe07feadc9.a: YouthWorks is a national employment readiness and career pathways program that started in 2017 at Children's Aid Foundation of Canada. It operates across 6 partners in Canada in 4 different jurisdictions. Since the program started, it has helped over almost 4,000 youth with employment readiness and building the soft skills required to get a job.

b9ed6d739e.q: What are the main reasons youth in care drop out of post-secondary education according to Children's Aid Foundation data?
b9ed6d739e.a: Based on 10 years of scholarship recipient data, youth drop out in their first year of post-secondary overwhelmingly because of mental health crises, inability to pay rent and losing accommodations, or lack of concrete needs like food or books. While providing concrete resources is important, wraparound supports including mentors, peer resources, and safe places to stay are almost equally important to get kids through education.

22ae66ea3d.q: What role should corporate partnerships play in supporting youth in care according to Jeffrey Schiffer?
22ae66ea3d.a: Corporate partnerships should go beyond simply providing funding to get kids employment-ready. They must provide actual opportunities including internships, summer placements, mentorships, and eventually hiring. Royal Bank of Canada and the RBC Foundation exemplify this by providing resources to create the YouthWorks program and then streaming youth into actual job placements and careers.

715cf8ffe0.q: How many youth in out-of-home care are living in Canada on any given day?
715cf8ffe0.a: There are about 61,000 youth in Canada living in out-of-home care each day, any given day. These youth often slip through the cracks between education, child welfare, and health systems before becoming involved with child welfare, and many leave the system without adequate support.
